welcome.text: Welcome to kal-toh. I'll guide you through your first game. You can turn my voice off under the stone whenever you like.

touchTray.text: The tan resting at the bottom of the screen is yours to place. Touch it with one finger to pick it up.

dangling.text: It's dangling from one finger. Put a second finger down, and you'll hold it with both.

danglingAgain.text: Add a second finger to hold it with both.

holding.text: Now lay its two ends on two pieces of the structure. Spread your fingers wide, so you can see where the ends land.

blue.text: Blue means it can rest there. Lift both fingers together to place it.

amber.text: Amber means it can't rest there. Move it until its ends touch two pieces.

amberAgain.text: Still amber. Try two other pieces.

droppedOne.text: You let go with one finger before it was placed, so it slipped back to the tray. Keep both fingers down until it glows blue, then lift them together.

missed.text: Its ends weren't resting on two pieces, so it went back to the tray. Try again.

placedFirst.text: Well done. That's your first tan placed.

idle.text: Take your time. When you're ready, pick up the tan at the bottom of the screen.

turnStone.text: You can turn the stone by dragging it. Sideways spins it, up and down tilts it.

twoFingerTurn.text: With two fingers on the stone, twist to turn it as you see it, and pinch to draw nearer.

flipHint.text: There's more under the stone. Drag it upward until its underside faces you.

flipped.text: This is the underside of the stone. Everything is here: the ways to play, players, music, sound, and my voice. Touch any option to change it.

flippedBack.text: To turn it back over, drag the stone down again.

chooseWay.text: Choose a way to play, then touch Shake, or shake your phone, to begin a new game.

wayKaltoh.text: Next game, the original kal-toh. Touch Shake to begin.

wayForms.text: Next game, many forms. Touch Shake to begin.

wayZen.text: Next game, zen. Touch Shake to begin.

translate.text: The Starfleet delta translates the carving between English and Vulcan.

shakeHint.text: Shaking your phone also begins a new game.

startZen.text: This is zen. Lay each tan across any two pieces. There are no wrong moves here.

zenTen.text: Every ten tan you place, the whole structure transforms into a new form.

zenComplete.text: It is fully formed. Shake your phone, or touch Shake under the stone, to begin again.

startKaltoh.text: This is the original kal-toh. The jumble hides two nested shapes. Join two tips that belong together. True neighbours glow blue and bring order. A wrong pair brings discord, and pieces fall.

discord.text: Discord. Those weren't neighbours, so pieces fell. Look for tips the right distance apart.

tooFar.text: Those tips are too far apart for one tan.

startForms.text: This is many forms. A different shape hides in the jumble each game. Look for the angles that repeat, and close its loops one at a time.

struts.text: Struts brace outward from each loop you close. When the inner form is whole, build the same form again on their tips.

complete.text: Complete. Beautifully done. Shake to begin again.

twoPlayers.text: Two players take turns. Pass the phone once your tan is placed. Whose turn it is is carved under the stone.

guideOff.text: Voice guidance is off. You can turn it back on under the stone.

form_tetra.text: It has become a truncated tetrahedron.

form_octa.text: It has become a truncated octahedron.

form_cube.text: It has become a truncated cube.

form_prism5.text: It has become a pentagonal prism.

form_prism6.text: It has become a hexagonal prism.

form_prism7.text: It has become a heptagonal prism.

form_prism8.text: It has become an octagonal prism.

form_anti4.text: It has become a square antiprism.

form_anti5.text: It has become a pentagonal antiprism.

form_anti6.text: It has become a hexagonal antiprism.

form_anti7.text: It has become a heptagonal antiprism.

form_anti8.text: It has become an octagonal antiprism.
